title: Colosseum 1.1.10
summary: Open Vault as its own world, update configurable addons online, read MangaSin on your device, and keep playback and Linux accounts reliable.

highlights.title: A world of its own
highlights.body: Vault opens with its own background instead of leaving the previous world visible underneath.

highlights.title: Updates through Workers
highlights.body: Tankoyomi and Tankorent use online addon delivery while downloads and torrent handling stay on your device. Existing source settings are preserved.

highlights.title: Read in Spanish
highlights.body: Enable MangaSin in Tankoyomi to search and read directly from your device, with signed addon updates. The source is optional and starts disabled.

highlights.title: Load and recover reliably
highlights.body: The video player handles loading failures and preserves the playback position when retrying a failed stream.

highlights.title: Keep credentials secure
highlights.body: Accounts use the desktop Secret Service keyring. Locked or unavailable keyrings return an error without claiming credentials were deleted.

highlights.title: A new update version
highlights.body: Windows installations can recognize 1.1.10 as newer than 1.1.9. Linux updates remain manual.
